beats.say: Form Studio is where you build and fix the EMR's clinical forms in the browser, without writing code. This guide shows the main steps.
Open it from the app menu at the top right. Choose Form Studio.
The start page has two halves. On the left are three ways to make a new form: from scratch, from a Bahmni export, or from an Excel template.
On the right is the table of all three hundred forms in this EMR. Type in the search box to narrow it. Here, gynecology.
Press Edit schema on Emergency Triage Form, Gynecology. The editor opens.
On the left are three views: Preview and edit, Rules, and the Schema editor. On the right are the live form preview and a panel for the checks and downloads.
Every page, section and question has a pencil to edit it and a bin to delete it. Press the pencil on a section to rename it.
The new name shows in the form straight away, and in the form's JSON.
To add a question, press Add question. Give it a label, an ID and a type, then search for its concept.
Concepts are listed with the best match first. Pick one and save. The new question is in the form.
Now a rule. The question PV should appear only when Vaginal Bleeding is Yes. Open the rules for PV.
Choose Only when. Pick Vaginal Bleeding, tick Yes, and save.
The rule is written under PV as a plain sentence. There is no expression to type.
The preview obeys it. PV is hidden. Choose Yes for Vaginal Bleeding, and PV appears.
Before a form leaves Form Studio, press Check concepts on the server. It looks up every concept the form uses.
Zero errors. Download content files is now enabled. It gives a zip with the form and a short README.
Back on the start page, a new form from an Excel template. You can download an empty template or a filled example. Here we upload the example.
Form Studio reads the sheet and matches its concepts on the server. Nine pages, twenty-three sections, one hundred and sixty questions.
Open it in the editor and run the Check. Forty-four errors, under Must fix before export.
Each one is a question whose concept still has to be picked. Pick it with the question's pencil, or use Create new concepts. The download stays blocked until the list is empty.
Last, the concept dictionary. It holds every concept read from this EMR's database.
Search weight, in kilograms. Weight first, with its synonyms, its datatype, and the number of forms that use it.
Open the row to see its names, answers and mappings, and the list of forms that use it.
Form Studio: edit forms, write rules in plain words, and check every concept before export.
